rules.title: Annual Allowable Rent Increase under San Francisco Rent Ordinance
rules.requirement: Landlords covered by the San Francisco Rent Ordinance may raise rent only up to the annually published allowable percentage set by the Rent Board; for March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 that allowable increase is 1.6%.
rules.interaction: The Rent Board publishes a new allowable percentage each year (1.4% for 3/1/25-2/28/26; 1.7% for 3/1/24-2/28/25), tied to CPI under the Rent Ordinance's annual increase formula.

rules.title: Required Interest Rate on Residential Security Deposits
rules.requirement: San Francisco landlords must pay tenants annual interest on security deposits at the rate published yearly by the Rent Board; for March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 that rate is 4.2%.
rules.interaction: Prior rates were 5.0% (3/1/25-2/28/26) and 5.2% (3/1/24-2/28/25); the rate is reset annually.
rules.conflict_note: Document does not state the specific Administrative Code section for the security-deposit interest requirement; the chapter citation is inferred, not quoted from this source.

rules.title: Relocation Payments for Owner/Relative Move-in, Demolition, Temporary Capital Improvement, or Substantial Rehabilitation Evictions
rules.requirement: When a San Francisco landlord terminates a tenancy for owner/relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal of the unit from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation, the landlord must pay relocation assistance to each tenant, up to a maximum per unit, plus an additional amount for each elderly (60+) or disabled tenant or household with minor children.
rules.key_value: $8,245.00 per tenant; $24,733.00 max per unit; +$5,497.00 for each elderly (60+)/disabled tenant or household with minor children (3/1/26-2/28/27)
rules.exemptions: Relocation payments for temporary capital improvement displacement lasting less than 20 days are instead governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9, not this section.
rules.interaction: Rates are republished each period; prior period (3/1/25-2/28/26) amounts were $8,062.00 per tenant, $24,184.00 max per unit, +$5,375.00 additional.
rules.quoted_span: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation

rules.title: Relocation Payments for Tenants Evicted Under the Ellis Act
rules.requirement: Landlords who withdraw units from rental housing use under the Ellis Act must pay relocation assistance to each tenant, up to a maximum per unit, plus an additional amount for each elderly (62+) or disabled tenant.
rules.key_value: $11,110.05 per tenant; $33,330.13 max per unit; +$7,443.90 for each elderly (62+)/disabled tenant (3/1/26-2/28/27)
rules.interaction: Rates are republished each period; prior period (3/1/25-2/28/26) amounts were $10,863.45 per tenant, $32,590.33 max per unit, +$7,278.67 additional.
rules.quoted_span: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act

rules.title: Relocation Payments for Temporary Displacement Under 20 Days for Capital Improvement Work
rules.requirement: When a tenant is temporarily displaced for less than 20 days to allow capital improvement work, relocation payments are governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 rather than the San Francisco Rent Ordinance's general relocation provision; San Francisco publishes a daily relocation rate used in that context of $446.00/day plus actual moving expenses for March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.
rules.interaction: Prior period (3/1/25-2/28/26) rate was $436.00/day plus actual moving expenses.
rules.quoted_span: The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
